heroHeadline: Bad Bunny's Tour Finale Call Sparks Thousands-Strong March Against Puerto Rico's Esencia Megaproject
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny wrapped the "Debí Tirar Más Fotos – Cerramos en Casa" homecoming stand at Estadio Hiram Bithorn with a second, definitive closing night on August 23, ending the $467.5M+-grossing World Tour after 57 shows and roughly 3.1 million tickets sold across four continents. Both San Juan nights doubled as a platform for the island's water and power crisis — night one (Aug 22) opened with a speech calling the dysfunction "created on purpose" and flashed an on-screen call, "Esencia no va," urging fans to a Aug 23 march in Cabo Rojo; night two closed the tour with demands that the Proyecto Esencia megaproject "must be canceled" and surprise guests including Rauw Alejandro and Víctor Manuelle. That same afternoon, hundreds answered the call at the Coalición Defiende a Cabo Rojo's "Cabo Rojo es nuestro" march, the most direct real-world action yet triggered by his tour-ending activism.
